summary.goal: Interface for humans to approve or reject gates with full context. The primary human-in-the-loop interaction point.

acceptance_criteria.description: Gate details panel: step title, description, verification results summary
Artifacts section with clickable links (PRs, test reports, deployments)
Optional notes textarea for approval/rejection comments
Approve button (green, prominent) calls POST /gates/:id/approve
Reject button (red, secondary) calls POST /gates/:id/reject
Confirmation dialog before reject to prevent accidents
Badge count in status bar when gates are pending
Sound notification option for new gates

observations: Approval stores approver identity and timestamp
Rejection pauses run and may trigger change request
patterns: Modal or slide-over panel for gate details

acceptance_criteria.description: getPendingGates(runId?: string) returns { gates: Gate[] }
getGate(taskId) returns gate details with task context
approveGate(taskId, comment?: string) calls POST /gates/:taskId/approve
rejectGate(taskId, reason: string) calls POST /gates/:taskId/reject
Gate type: { gate_id, task_id, run_id, task_title, task_description, approver_role, status, artifacts, created_at }

acceptance_criteria.description: Modal or slide-over panel
Task details section: title, description, scope, acceptance criteria
Verification results if available (from auditor)

Notes textarea for comments
Approve button (prominent, green)
Reject button (secondary, red)
